workflow_prerequisites.native_word: Run native-only steps only when the operation_statuses entry is SUPPORTED_NATIVE; otherwise stop and report the unavailable fidelity requirement.

delivery_gates.requested_features: Every requested feature must be observed semantically at the requested depth; visible lookalikes do not count.
delivery_gates.course_essay_evidence_matrix: Before drafting, build project-specific acceptance, requirement, outline and visual inventories from the assignment, rubric, selected profile and read-only source project. Use StrongWine only as a qualitative depth and style comparator; do not copy its headings, counts or facts. Counts come from the current project and its questions, not a fixed quota. Map every required heading, project claim and planned asset to its authority/source and review status. Inspect database entities/schema only as needed to explain the actual system; enumerate actual GET views and templates, and distinguish source-backed wireframes from screenshots captured from a running app. Include, adapt, or record a reviewer-approved not-applicable decision with a reason for each relevant comparator group. Missing rubric, source or runtime evidence remains INCOMPLETE.
delivery_gates.dynamic_fields: Requested TOC, REF, PAGEREF, PAGE, NUMPAGES, and SEQ fields must be present and UPDATED_NATIVE after a Word reopen/update; placeholder or stale results are FAIL.
delivery_gates.visual_page_audit: Inspect the visible content of every rendered page; image existence, file size, and dimensions alone are not a content audit. Unexpected blank or near-blank pages are FAIL.
delivery_gates.negative_tests: Each negative test must exercise the exact requested invariant; harness misuse, unknown options, or unrelated exceptions are FAIL, not a passing fail-closed result.
delivery_gates.evidence: Never invent a source. Synthetic QA records must set synthetic=true and remain visibly labeled in citations and bibliography.
delivery_gates.academic_integrity: Run integrity audit with the exact profile variant and evidence registry. Synthetic evidence, unresolved placeholders, stale hashes, missing bibliography entries, and invisible spoofing characters are not waivable PASS results. Style heuristics require human review and are never AI-authorship evidence.
delivery_gates.contradiction_policy: FAIL if any JSON result, reopened Word semantic check, rendered page, or test log contradicts the summary.
delivery_gates.unavailable_policy: UNAVAILABLE or REVIEW_REQUIRED is never PASS.

document_construction_order: Before composition or editing, freeze the user-specific assignment/rubric/profile checks and map each requirement to a report section and evidence artifact; keep missing inputs explicitly NOT_RUN.

Use an accepted full-report example such as StrongWine to review depth and style, then derive the outline and asset inventory from this project's requirements and evidence. Record each applicable, adapted, or reviewer-approved not-applicable group; never use example counts as quotas.

Enumerate every heading expected in the final DOCX, including generated front matter, lists, references and appendices. Do not rely on compose or a matrix generator to silently add headings that are absent from the approved outline.
Choose compose and reusable helper scripts according to document size and project needs. There is no universal visible-character target; review generated scripts before using them.
Compose substantive content, real Heading styles, stable anchors, evidence-linked citations, and the existing bibliography section before layout operations.
Use one version-1 apply plan for compatible mutating operations so a failed step rolls back and no intermediate DOCX is published.
Insert section breaks with selectors at real content boundaries, then apply layout to the resulting section indexes.
Insert TOC, captions, cross-references, and pagination, then update fields through Word native when required.
Run integrity audit/provenance, inspect, validate, verify, native reopen, and content-aware page audit before delivery.

delivery_completion_sequence.first_pass: Run verify with --native-fields --render --engine word. REVIEW_REQUIRED is expected until page images are actually inspected.
delivery_completion_sequence.human_or_agent_review: Inspect the visible content of every path in render.page_images and reject blank, clipped, overflowing, duplicated, or malformed pages. Preserve visual_review_challenge.token, which is bound to the exact document and ordered page-image hashes.
delivery_completion_sequence.final_pass: Only after that inspection, rerun the same verify command with --visual-reviewed --visual-review-token TOKEN_FROM_CHALLENGE. PASS is valid only when the current page hashes still match and all other gates also pass.

create_report.on_unavailable: Stop and report INCOMPLETE; never bypass the CLI with ad-hoc COM or call the document delivery-ready.
steps: wordassistant compose report.docx --output authored.docx --content content.json --evidence report-evidence.json --json
wordassistant integrity audit refreshed.docx --evidence report-evidence.json --profile generic --variant default --json
wordassistant integrity provenance refreshed.docx --evidence report-evidence.json --profile generic --variant default --output refreshed.provenance.json --json
wordassistant verify refreshed.docx --profile generic --variant default --native-fields --render --engine word --json
wordassistant verify refreshed.docx --profile generic --variant default --native-fields --render --engine word --visual-reviewed --visual-review-token TOKEN_FROM_CHALLENGE --delivery --json

layout_change.on_unavailable: Stop before native-only steps and report that dynamic-field freshness and Word-native render remain unverified.
